stun:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original pixel-art RPG status VFX sprite sheet for After333, Stun.
Primary request: eight animation frames of golden five-pointed stars revolving in a horizontal elliptical orbit above a stunned unit's head. No character. The user's cartoon reference is conceptual only: small yellow stars orbiting an ellipse. Make original sharp pixel art rather than copying linework or any watermark.
Layout: exactly 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, 8 separate evenly spaced square cells, read left to right then top to bottom; wide 2:1 sheet, preferred 2048 by 1024. Same ellipse center and size in every cell, no visible grid/labels. Each cell will become 512 by 512, all artwork safely inside a 32 pixel border. In each cell the halo is centered around y=256 and spans about x=80..432, y=174..338. 4 gold stars of different sizes along the orbit; stars travel clockwise smoothly between frames by 45 degrees, unchanged ellipse. Front stars larger/bright gold, back stars smaller/pale yellow to read depth. Delicate muted golden elliptical arc/trail, no thick black outlines. A complete looping orbit, frame8 flows into frame1.
Style: crisp restrained retro pixel art, limited gold/yellow palette, light amber outline, stepped edges, legible at small mobile size, no blurry outer glow. Transparent empty center around the implied head, no unit or head.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no white/black/checkerboard painted backdrop, no text, no watermark, no cross-cell overlap, no sparks outside margins, no visible unit. Keep all frames the same scale and fixed center.
freeze:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original pixel-art RPG status VFX sprite, Freeze, for After333.
Primary request: a single large transparent icy crystal prison enclosing a frozen game unit. Draw only the ice shell, no character or creature inside.
Composition: one upright faceted ice crystal with a broad lower base, gently tapered shoulders and jagged pointed top, front-view with slight 3D facets. Centered on a square transparent canvas. Crystal occupies x~70..442 and y~32..480 in eventual 512 by512 sprite, complete uncropped silhouette, at least16px safe empty margin. Keep generous empty transparent interior to show the original game unit clearly underneath. Frosty cyan/slate-blue facet edges and lightly frosted pale-blue panes; interior panes very translucent (roughly15-25% alpha), brighter icy contour edges thin and partly translucent, tiny white highlights near top/side only. The shell must be visibly transparent, do not make an opaque blue block or fill the center white.
Style: crisp polished retro pixel art matching pixel-art fantasy/card units, stepped edges, angular crystalline planes, limited pale cyan/ice blue palette, clean outline. No blurred mist or large glow.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha including semitransparent material surfaces, no painted white/black/checkerboard background, no text or watermark, no floor/environment, no character or props, no snow cloud obstructing the center, no background shadow. Single crystal only.
